ad_spend_facts.sql: select i.date, case i.platform when 'instagram' then 'Instagram Ads' when 'messenger' then 'Messenger Ads' else 'Facebook Ads' end as source, i.campaign_id as campaign_key, coalesce(mc.name, ('Campaign ' || i.campaign_id)) as campaign_name, i.adset_id as adset_key, coalesce(ms.name, ('Ad set ' || i.adset_id)) as adset_name, i.ad_id as ad_key, coalesce(ma.name, ('Ad ' || i.ad_id)) as ad_name, i.cost, i.impressions, i.link_clicks as clicks, i.purchases from (((meta_ad_insights i left join meta_campaigns mc on ((mc.id = i.campaign_id))) left join meta_adsets ms on ((ms.id = i.adset_id))) left join meta_ads ma on ((ma.id = i.ad_id))) where ((i.cost > 0) or (i.impressions > 0)) union all select s.spend_date as date, case c.platform when 'GOOGLE' then 'Google Ads' when 'TIKTOK' then 'TikTok Ads' when 'META' then 'Facebook Ads' else 'Other ads' end as source, case when (c.source = 'API') then c.external_id else ('mc:' || c.id) end as campaign_key, c.name as campaign_name, null as adset_key, null as adset_name, null as ad_key, null as ad_name, s.spend as cost, coalesce(s.impressions, 0) as impressions, coalesce(s.clicks, 0) as clicks, s.orders as purchases from (marketing_spend s join marketing_campaigns c on ((c.id = s.campaign_id))) where (not ((c.platform = 'META') and (c.source = 'API')))

inventory_overview.pg:
SELECT v.id AS variant_id,
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.slug AS product_slug,
    p.status AS product_status,
    p.track_inventory,
    c.name AS category_name,
    v.sku,
    v.title AS variant_title,
    v.is_active AS variant_active,
    COALESCE(v.cost_price, p.cost_price) AS unit_cost,
    COALESCE(v.price, p.price) AS unit_price,
    i.on_hand,
    i.reserved,
    i.available,
    i.damaged,
    COALESCE(p.low_stock_threshold, (setting_numeric('inventory'::text, ARRAY['low_stock_threshold'::text], (5)::numeric))::integer) AS low_stock_threshold,
        CASE
            WHEN (NOT p.track_inventory) THEN 'UNTRACKED'::text
            WHEN (i.available <= 0) THEN 'OUT_OF_STOCK'::text
            WHEN (i.available <= COALESCE(p.low_stock_threshold, (setting_numeric('inventory'::text, ARRAY['low_stock_threshold'::text], (5)::numeric))::integer)) THEN 'LOW_STOCK'::text
            ELSE 'IN_STOCK'::text
        END AS stock_status,
    round(((i.on_hand)::numeric * COALESCE(v.cost_price, p.cost_price)), 2) AS stock_value,
    i.updated_at
   FROM (((product_variants v
     JOIN products p ON ((p.id = v.product_id)))
     JOIN inventory i ON ((i.variant_id = v.id)))
     LEFT JOIN categories c ON ((c.id = p.category_id)));

marketing_campaign_performance.pg:
SELECT c.id AS campaign_id,
    c.platform,
    c.name,
    c.status,
    c.utm_campaign,
    c.start_date,
    c.end_date,
    COALESCE(s.spend, (0)::numeric) AS spend,
    COALESCE(s.orders, (0)::bigint) AS reported_orders,
    COALESCE(s.revenue, (0)::numeric) AS reported_revenue,
    COALESCE(a.orders, (0)::bigint) AS attributed_orders,
    COALESCE(a.revenue, (0)::numeric) AS attributed_revenue,
    COALESCE(a.gross_profit, (0)::numeric) AS attributed_gross_profit,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(s.spend, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round((COALESCE(s.revenue, (0)::numeric) / s.spend), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS roas,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(s.orders, (0)::bigint) > 0) THEN round((s.spend / (s.orders)::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cpa,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(s.orders, (0)::bigint) + COALESCE(a.orders, (0)::bigint)) > 0) THEN round((COALESCE(s.spend, (0)::numeric) / (GREATEST(COALESCE(s.orders, (0)::bigint), COALESCE(a.orders, (0)::bigint)))::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cost_per_order,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(s.spend, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (a.revenue IS NOT NULL)) THEN round((a.revenue / s.spend), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS attributed_roas,
    (COALESCE(a.gross_profit, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(s.spend, (0)::numeric)) AS profit_after_ad_spend
   FROM ((marketing_campaigns c
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT marketing_spend.campaign_id,
            sum(marketing_spend.spend) AS spend,
            sum(marketing_spend.orders) AS orders,
            sum(marketing_spend.revenue) AS revenue
           FROM marketing_spend
          GROUP BY marketing_spend.campaign_id) s ON ((s.campaign_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.utm_campaign,
            count(*) AS orders,
            sum(o.total_amount) AS revenue,
            sum(((o.subtotal - o.discount_total) - order_cost_total(o.id))) AS gross_profit
           FROM orders o
          WHERE ((o.utm_campaign IS NOT NULL) AND (o.status = ANY (ARRAY['DELIVERED'::order_status, 'RETURN_REQUESTED'::order_status])) AND (o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL))
          GROUP BY o.utm_campaign) a ON ((a.utm_campaign = c.utm_campaign)));

order_attribution_facts.pg:
SELECT o.id AS order_id,
    o.status,
    o.created_at,
    o.total_amount,
    o.confirmed_at,
    o.shipped_at,
    o.delivered_at,
    COALESCE(a.source, 'Unknown'::text) AS source,
    COALESCE(a.medium, 'Unknown'::text) AS medium,
    a.channel,
    a.is_paid,
    COALESCE(a.campaign_id, mcn.id,
        CASE
            WHEN (mk.id IS NOT NULL) THEN ('mc:'::text || mk.id)
            ELSE NULL::text
        END) AS campaign_key,
    COALESCE(mc.name, mcn.name, mk.name, a.campaign) AS campaign_name,
    a.adset_id AS adset_key,
    COALESCE(ms.name, a.adset) AS adset_name,
    a.ad_id AS ad_key,
    COALESCE(ma.name, a.ad) AS ad_name
   FROM ((((((orders o
     LEFT JOIN order_attributions a ON ((a.order_id = o.id)))
     LEFT JOIN meta_campaigns mc ON ((mc.id = a.campaign_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.id,
            m.name
           FROM meta_campaigns m
          WHERE ((a.campaign_id IS NULL) AND (a.campaign IS NOT NULL) AND (lower(m.name) = lower(a.campaign)))
          ORDER BY m.synced_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) mcn ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c.id,
            c.name
           FROM marketing_campaigns c
          WHERE ((a.campaign_id IS NULL) AND (mcn.id IS NULL) AND (a.campaign IS NOT NULL) AND (c.source <> 'API'::data_source) AND (lower(COALESCE(c.utm_campaign, c.name)) = lower(a.campaign)))
          ORDER BY c.created_at
         LIMIT 1) mk ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN meta_adsets ms ON ((ms.id = a.adset_id)))
     LEFT JOIN meta_ads ma ON ((ma.id = a.ad_id)));

v_courier_performance.sql: select c.id as courier_id, c.name, count(s.id) as shipments, count(s.id) filter (where (s.status = 'DELIVERED')) as delivered, count(s.id) filter (where (s.status IN ('FAILED', 'RETURNED', 'RETURNING'))) as failed_or_returned, coalesce(sum(s.shipping_cost), 0) as shipping_cost from (couriers c left join shipments s on (((s.courier_id = c.id) and (s.status <> 'CANCELLED')))) group by c.id, c.name

v_customer_statistics.sql: select segment, count(*) as customers, sum(total_orders) as orders, sum(total_spent) as total_spent, round(avg(nullif(average_order_value, 0)), 2) as average_order_value from customers group by segment

v_daily_sales.pg:
SELECT _local_date(created_at) AS day,
    count(*) AS orders,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::order_status, 'REJECTED_FRAUD'::order_status]))) AS valid_orders,
    COALESCE(sum(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE (status <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::order_status, 'REJECTED_FRAUD'::order_status]))), (0)::numeric) AS gross_sales,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'CANCELLED'::order_status)) AS cancelled,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (delivered_at IS NOT NULL)) AS delivered
   FROM orders
  GROUP BY (_local_date(created_at));

v_fraud_performance.sql: select date( (strftime('%Y-%m-01T00:00:00.000Z', created_at )) ) as month, decision, risk_level, count(*) as checks, round(avg(risk_score), 2) as avg_score from fraud_checks group by (date( (strftime('%Y-%m-01T00:00:00.000Z', created_at )) )), decision, risk_level

v_inventory_valuation.sql: select product_id, product_name, sum((SELECT max(v) FROM ( SELECT on_hand AS v  UNION ALL SELECT 0 ))) as units, sum(reserved) as reserved, sum(damaged) as damaged, sum((CAST( ((SELECT max(v) FROM ( SELECT on_hand AS v  UNION ALL SELECT 0 )))  AS REAL) * unit_cost)) as value_at_cost, sum((CAST( ((SELECT max(v) FROM ( SELECT on_hand AS v  UNION ALL SELECT 0 )))  AS REAL) * unit_price)) as value_at_retail from inventory_overview where track_inventory group by product_id, product_name

v_monthly_sales.pg:
SELECT (date_trunc('month'::text, (_local_date(created_at))::timestamp without time zone))::date AS month,
    count(*) AS orders,
    COALESCE(sum(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE (status <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::order_status, 'REJECTED_FRAUD'::order_status]))), (0)::numeric) AS gross_sales,
    (COALESCE(avg(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE (status <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::order_status, 'REJECTED_FRAUD'::order_status]))), (0)::numeric))::numeric(12,2) AS average_order_value
   FROM orders
  GROUP BY ((date_trunc('month'::text, (_local_date(created_at))::timestamp without time zone))::date);

v_order_statistics.sql: select status, count(*) as orders, coalesce(sum(total_amount), 0) as value from orders group by status

v_profit_summary.sql: select date( (strftime('%Y-%m-01T00:00:00.000Z', (ft.txn_date) )) ) as month, coalesce(sum(ft.amount) filter (where (c.pnl_group IN ('REVENUE', 'DELIVERY_INCOME'))), 0) as revenue, coalesce(sum(ft.amount) filter (where (c.pnl_group = 'CONTRA_REVENUE')), 0) as refunds, coalesce(sum(ft.amount) filter (where (c.pnl_group = 'COGS')), 0) as cogs, coalesce(sum(ft.amount) filter (where (c.pnl_group = 'OPERATING_EXPENSE')), 0) as operating_expenses, coalesce(sum(ft.amount) filter (where (c.pnl_group = 'OTHER_INCOME')), 0) as other_income, (coalesce(sum(ft.amount) filter (where (c.pnl_group IN ('REVENUE', 'DELIVERY_INCOME', 'OTHER_INCOME'))), 0) - coalesce(sum(ft.amount) filter (where (c.pnl_group IN ('CONTRA_REVENUE', 'COGS', 'OPERATING_EXPENSE'))), 0)) as net_profit from (finance_transactions ft join finance_categories c on ((c.id = ft.category_id))) group by (date( (strftime('%Y-%m-01T00:00:00.000Z', (ft.txn_date) )) ))
